violations.affected_code: GestureDetector(onTap: widget.onTap, child: Focus(... child: Container(... child: ExcludeSemantics(child: Image(image: widget.thumb)))))
violations.explanation: The interactive thumbnail has no Semantics wrapper with button: true and a label. The image is excluded from semantics, so screen readers get no name, no button role, and possibly no node at all for this control. Users cannot tell what the control does.
The focus border is a semi-transparent white. It may lack sufficient contrast (3:1) against light backgrounds or light thumbnail images, which makes keyboard focus hard to see.

violations.type: Custom focus handling without semantic tap action
violations.explanation: Keyboard activation is implemented manually through Focus and GestureDetector rather than a semantic button widget such as InkWell or a button with Semantics. Without an explicit Semantics onTap and button flag, assistive technologies may not expose an activate action.
